theorems.notes: Proof of the HAND-EDITED statement (from OLD_wasm2.0.lean, moved below `inductive Store_ok`, with the extra `Store_ok (fun_store z)` premise); probe copy is named Step_read_is_wf_edited and its statement is byte-identical to OLD's apart from the name. One `cases h with` over all 47 Step_read rules. Store_ok is used only through three new helpers built on the accessor relations' bounds premises: iswf_fun_table_len_lt (table.size, table.fill-succ, table.copy-le/gt, table.init-succ), iswf_fun_elem_len_lt (table.init-succ), iswf_fun_mem_len_le (memory.size, memory.copy-gt). memory.init-succ's pushed byte is bounded by the rule's own `i < |data.BYTES|` premise plus wf_state (via data_is_wf), and memory.fill/copy/init push wrapping `$iadd_(32, _, 1)` (no bound needed). No default value is used: every `l[k]!` is rewritten with getElem!_pos under a bounds premise, and every `Option.get!` is on `some` or guarded by a `≠ none` premise. Calls generated theorems that are still sorry in the import (local_is_wf, global_is_wf, data_is_wf), so #print axioms shows sorryAx, plus the generated axioms extend___is_wf, inv_lanes__is_wf, lanes__is_wf. Compiles under default heartbeats; the whole Final.lean takes about 1.3 s.

theorems.name: Step_is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  intro hcfg hsok h
  obtain ⟨hst, hais⟩ : wf_state z ∧ Forall (fun e => wf_admininstr e) admininstr_lst := by
    cases hcfg with | config_case_0 _ _ h1 h2 => exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  cases h with
  | pure z admininstr_lst admininstr'_lst h0 =>
    exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ hst (Step_pure_is_wf _ _ hais h0)
  | read z admininstr_lst admininstr'_lst h0 =>
    exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ hst (Step_read_is_wf_edited _ _ _ hcfg hsok h0)
  | ctxt_label z v_n instr_0_lst admininstr_lst z' admininstr'_lst h0 h1 h2 =>
    have hl := hais _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)
    cases hl with
    | admininstr_case_71 _ _ _ hi _ =>
      cases h2 with
      | config_case_0 _ _ hst' hais' =>
        exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ hst'
          (iswf_Forall_cons (wf_admininstr.admininstr_case_71 _ _ _ hi hais') (iswf_Forall_nil _))
  | ctxt_frame s f v_n f' admininstr_lst s' f'' admininstr'_lst h0 h1 h2 =>
    cases hst with
    | state_case_0 _ _ _ hf =>
      cases h2 with
      | config_case_0 _ _ hst' hais' =>
        cases hst' with
        | state_case_0 _ _ hs' hf'' =>
          exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ (wf_state.state_case_0 _ _ hs' hf)
            (iswf_Forall_cons (wf_admininstr.admininstr_case_72 _ _ _ hf'' hais') (iswf_Forall_nil _))
  | ctxt_instrs z val_lst admininstr_lst admininstr_1_lst z' admininstr'_lst h0 h1 h2 h3 =>
    cases h3 with
    | config_case_0 _ _ hst' hais' =>
      exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ hst' (iswf_Forall_append (fun x hx => hais x (by simp [hx]))
        (iswf_Forall_append hais' (fun x hx => hais x (by simp [hx]))))
  | local_set z v_val x =>
    have hv := hais (admininstr_val v_val) (by simp)
    have hx := hais (admininstr.LOCAL_SET x) (by simp)
    cases hx with
    | admininstr_case_44 _ hx =>
      exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ (with_local_is_wf _ _ _ _ hst hx (iswf_val_of_admininstr hv) rfl)
        (iswf_Forall_nil _)
  | global_set z v_val x var_0 h0 =>
    have hv := hais (admininstr_val v_val) (by simp)
    have hx := hais (admininstr.GLOBAL_SET x) (by simp)
    cases hx with
    | admininstr_case_47 _ hx =>
      exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ (with_global_is_wf _ _ _ _ _ h0 hst hx (iswf_val_of_admininstr hv) rfl)
        (iswf_Forall_nil _)
  | table_set_trap =>
    exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ hst (iswf_Forall_cons (by constructor) (iswf_Forall_nil _))
  | table_set_val z i v_ref x var_1 var_0 h0 h1 h2 h3 =>
    have hx := hais (admininstr.TABLE_SET x) (by simp)
    cases hx with
    | admininstr_case_49 _ hx =>
      exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ (with_table_is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 hst hx rfl) (iswf_Forall_nil _)
  | table_grow_succeed z v_ref v_n x ti var_2 var_1 var_0 h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 =>
    have hx := hais (admininstr.TABLE_GROW x) (by simp)
    cases hx with
    | admininstr_case_51 _ hx =>
      have hti := growtable_is_wf _ _ _ _ _ h0 (table_is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 hst hx rfl) h3 h4.symm
      exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ (with_tableinst_is_wf _ _ _ _ _ h2 hst hx hti rfl)
        (iswf_Forall_cons (iswf_I32_const _ (iswf_fun_table_len_lt hsok h1)) (iswf_Forall_nil _))
  | table_grow_fail z v_ref v_n x var_0 h0 =>
    exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ hst
      (iswf_Forall_cons (iswf_I32_const _ (iswf_uN_lt (iswf_inv_signed h0))) (iswf_Forall_nil _))
  | elem_drop z x var_0 h0 =>
    have hx := hais (admininstr.ELEM_DROP x) (by simp)
    cases hx with
    | admininstr_case_55 _ hx =>
      exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ (with_elem_is_wf _ _ _ _ _ h0 hst hx rfl) (iswf_Forall_nil _)
  | store_num_trap =>
    exact wf_config.config_case_0 _ _ hst (iswf_Forall_cons (by constructor) (iswf_Forall_nil _))
  | store_num_val z i nt c ao b_lst var_0 h0 h1 h2 h3 =>

    cases hc with
    | admininstr_case_13 _ _ hc =>

  | store_pack_val z i v_Inn c v_n ao b_lst var_0 h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 =>
    have hc := hais (admininstr.CONST (numtype_Inn v_Inn) c) (by simp)
    cases hc with

helpers.name: iswf_Forall₂_left_mem
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Forall₂_left_mem {α β : Type} {R : α → β → Prop} :
    ∀ (l1 : List α) (l2 : List β), Forall₂ R l1 l2 → l1.length = l2.length → ∀ x ∈ l1, ∃ y ∈ l2, R x y := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil => intro l2 _ _ x hx; cases hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro l2 h hlen x hx
    cases l2 with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons b u =>
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
      · exact ⟨b, by simp, h (x, b) (by simp)⟩
      · obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := ih u (fun p hp => h p (by simp [hp])) (by simpa using hlen) x hx'
        exact ⟨y, by simp [hy], hr⟩
helpers.notes: Verbatim OLD helper. OLD also uses it in a vcvtop theorem and in Step_pure_is_wf, so another agent may return it too; keep one copy, above its first user.

helpers.name: iswf_Forall_of_Forall₂

theorem iswf_Forall_of_Forall₂ {α β : Type} {R : α → β → Prop} {Q : α → Prop} (l1 : List α) (l2 : List β) :
    Forall₂ R l1 l2 → l1.length = l2.length → (∀ a b, R a b → Q a) → Forall Q l1 := by
  intro h hlen hq x hx
  obtain ⟨y, _, hr⟩ := iswf_Forall₂_left_mem l1 l2 h hlen x hx
  exact hq x y hr
helpers.notes: Verbatim OLD helper.

helpers.name: iswf_Store_ok_table_len
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Store_ok_table_len {s : store} (hs : Store_ok s) :
    Forall (fun ti : tableinst => ti.REFS.length < 2 ^ 32) s.TABLES := by
  cases hs with
  | mk_Store_ok _ _ _ _ tis tts _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hlen htab _ _ _ _ _ _ hseq _ _ _ _ =>
    subst hseq
    refine iswf_Forall_of_Forall₂ tis tts htab hlen (fun a b hab => ?_)
    cases hab with
    | mk_Tableinst_ok v_n m_opt rt ref_lst htt _ hl _ _ _ =>
      cases htt with
      | mk_Tabletype_ok _ _ hlim _ =>
        have h1 : @LE.le Nat _ v_n (Int.toNat (((2 ^ 32) : Int) - (1 : Int))) := iswf_Limits_ok_le hlim
        have h2 : Int.toNat (((2 ^ 32) : Int) - (1 : Int)) = 4294967295 := by decide
        have hl' : @Eq Nat ref_lst.length v_n := hl
        show ref_lst.length < 2 ^ 32
        omega
helpers.notes: NEW. Every table of a Store_ok store has fewer than 2^32 refs, because Tabletype_ok bounds the limits min by 2^32-1 and Tableinst_ok sets |refs| = min. Stated over all of s.TABLES, so no indexing and no default. It mentions Store_ok/Tableinst_ok/Tabletype_ok, so it must be placed after `inductive Store_ok`, i.e. directly above the moved Step_read_is_wf. The `@LE.le Nat _` / `@Eq Nat` restatements are needed because facts about `v_n : n` (abbrev for Nat) are otherwise invisible to omega.

    cases hab with
    | mk_Meminst_ok v_n m_opt b_lst hmt hl _ _ _ =>
      cases hmt with
      | mk_Memtype_ok _ hlim _ =>
        have h1 : @LE.le Nat _ v_n (2 ^ 16) := iswf_Limits_ok_le hlim
        have hl' : @Eq Nat b_lst.length (v_n * (64 * 1024)) := hl
        show b_lst.length ≤ 2 ^ 32

helpers.name: iswf_rat_to_nat_floor
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_rat_to_nat_floor (r : Rat) : rat_to_nat r = r.floor.toNat := by
  unfold rat_to_nat
  rw [Rat.floor_def, Int.tdiv_eq_ediv, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]
  by_cases h : 0 ≤ r.num
  · simp [h]
  · have hd : (0 : Int) < (r.den : Int) := by have := r.den_pos; omega
    have h1 : r.num / (r.den : Int) < 0 := Int.ediv_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by omega) hd
    have hs : (r.den : Int).sign = 1 := Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos hd
    split <;> omega
helpers.notes: Verbatim OLD helper (core Rat lemmas only; compiles on v4.32.0).

  rw [iswf_rat_to_nat_floor]
  have h2 : r.floor ≤ ((n : Rat)).floor := Rat.floor_monotone h
  rw [← Rat.intCast_natCast, Rat.floor_intCast] at h2

theorem iswf_grow_pages (len v_n : Nat) (h : (len : Rat) / ((64 * Ki) : Rat) + (v_n : Rat) ≤ ((2 ^ 16) : Rat)) :
    rat_to_nat ((len : Rat) / ((64 * Ki) : Rat)) < 2 ^ 32 := by
  have h1 : (len : Rat) / ((64 * Ki) : Rat) ≤ (len : Rat) / ((64 * Ki) : Rat) + (v_n : Rat) := by
    have := (Rat.add_le_add_left (c := (len : Rat) / ((64 * Ki) : Rat))).mpr (Rat.natCast_nonneg (a := v_n))
    rwa [Rat.add_zero] at this
  have h2 : ((2 ^ 16) : Rat) = ((2 ^ 16 : Nat) : Rat) := by rw [Rat.natCast_pow]; rfl
  have h3 := iswf_rat_to_nat_le (Rat.le_trans h1 (h2 ▸ h))
  omega
